subject: 4 S03 ui_copy keys: add to REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS + regenerate ui-copy.defaults.json (you hold both), or release
body: Lead asked me to move four S03 strings into ui_copy. I have the config/app_config.yaml values and the web reads (AccountPage, SignInPage) ready: signin.unavailable_title 'Sign-in is unavailable'; account.settings_label 'Settings'; account.signed_in_as 'Signed in as'; account.name_too_long 'Use at most 120 characters.'. They must also be in REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS (apps/api/naadi_api/config_api/schemas.py: sign-in block and account block) and in packages/shared/ui-copy.defaults.json (UPDATE_UI_COPY_DEFAULTS=1 uv run pytest tests/config_api/test_ui_copy_defaults.py). You hold claims on both files. Either (a) release both for ~10 minutes and I land all of it in one commit, or (b) tell me your sha after you integrate and I rebase and add the four lines. Reply a or b.
